title: How Capitalism Changed the Face of War / The American War Machine, Explained
publisher_or_archive: Johnny Harris Media / YouTube Documentary Archive
summary: Investigative documentary exploring the historical evolution of the military-industrial complex, examining how the Industrial Revolution and private capitalism transformed warfare into a self-perpetuating commercial enterprise, how arms manufacturers engineer political invulnerability through subcontracting in hundreds of congressional districts, and why the US supplies major weaponry to over 100 sovereign nations.
